source_text: Contra ejusmodi clamat Dominus, ab his refraenat et revocat errantem plebem suam, dicens: Nolite audire sermones pseudoprophetarum, quoniam visiones cordis eorum frustrantur eos. Loquuntur, sed non ab ore Domini. Dicunt eis qui abjiciunt verbum Dei: Pax erit vobis et omnibus ambulantibus in voluntatibus suis. Omnis qui ambulat in errore cordis sui, non venient super eum mala. Non locutus sum ad eos, et ipsi prophetaverunt. Si stetissent in substantia mea, et audissent verba mea, et si docuissent populum meum, convertissem eos a malis cogitationibus eorum. Hos eosdem denuo Dominus designat et denotat dicens: Me dereliquerunt fontem aquae vivae, et effoderunt sibi lacus detricos, qui non possunt aquam portare. Quando aliud baptisma praeter unum esse non possit, baptizare se posse opinantur. Vitae fonte deserto, vitalis et salutaris aquae gratiam pollicentur. Non abluuntur illic homines, sed potius sordidantur; nec purgantur delicta, sed immo cumulantur. Non Deo nativitas illa, sed diabolo filios generat. Per mendacium nati Veritatis promissa non capiunt: de perfidia procreati fidei gratiam perdunt. Ad pacis praemium venire non possunt, qui pacem Domini discordiae furore ruperunt.
pass_a_gloss: The Lord cries out against those of this kind and restrains and recalls His erring people from them, saying: Do not listen to the speeches of false prophets, because the visions of their heart deceive them. They speak, but not from the mouth of the Lord. They say to those who reject the word of God: Peace will be to you and to all who walk in their wills. Everyone who walks in the error of his heart, evils will not come upon him. I did not speak to them, and they prophesied. If they had stood in My substance and heard My words and if they had taught My people, I would have turned them away from their evil thoughts. The Lord designates and denotes these same ones again, saying: They have abandoned Me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug out for themselves broken cisterns, which cannot hold water. When another baptism besides one cannot exist, they think they can baptize themselves. Having deserted the fountain of life, they promise the grace of vital and salutary water. Men are not cleansed there, but rather they are defiled; nor are sins purified, but rather they are accumulated. That birth is not of God, but of the devil, and it generates sons. Born through falsehood, they do not receive the promises of Truth: born of perfidy, they lose the grace of faith. They cannot come to the reward of peace, who have broken the peace of the Lord with the fury of discord.
pass_b_english: The Lord cries out against such people, holding back his straying people and calling them back. He says: "Do not listen to what false prophets say, because the visions of their own hearts deceive them. They speak, but not from the mouth of the Lord. They tell those who reject God's word, 'You will have peace,' and they say the same to everyone who follows their own desires. They claim, 'No harm will come to anyone who walks in the error of his heart.' I never spoke to them, yet they prophesied. If they had stood in my counsel and listened to my words, and if they had taught my people, I would have turned them away from their evil thoughts." The Lord identifies and denounces these same people once more, saying: "They have abandoned me, the fountain of living water, and dug cracked cisterns for themselves that cannot hold water. Since there cannot be any baptism besides the one, they imagine they can baptize themselves. After deserting the fountain of life, they promise the grace of vital, saving water. People are not cleansed there; they are defiled. Sins are not purged; they pile up. That birth does not come from God but from the devil, and it produces children for him. Born through falsehood, they cannot receive the promises of Truth; born of treachery, they lose the grace of faith. They cannot reach the reward of peace, because they have shattered the Lord's peace with the fury of discord."

review.notes: Pass B fails to maintain fidelity to the Latin regarding the conditional clause 'Si stetissent in substantia mea'. Pass A correctly translates 'substantia mea' as 'My substance', whereas Pass B renders it as 'my counsel', which is a semantic shift not supported by the Latin text. Additionally, Pass B introduces a causal conjunction 'because' in the final sentence ('because they have shattered...') where the Latin 'qui' functions as a relative pronoun describing the subject ('who have broken...').
reasons: Pass B deviates from the Latin 'Si stetissent in substantia mea' by translating it as 'If they had stood in my counsel', whereas the text specifies 'substance'.
Pass B alters the syntax of the final clause 'qui pacem Domini discordiae furore ruperunt' by using 'because they have shattered' instead of the relative 'who have broken'.
